classification: EXPLORATORY QA COMPLETE / APPLICATION CERTIFICATION INCOMPLETE
counting_notes: Exploratory observations are not a passed/failed automated test suite.
URL paths exclude the investigator's invalid /catalog/products probe. UUID variants normalize to one screen type.
Screenshots include viewport and full-page variants; they are not 224 distinct screens.
Initial desktop/mobile contexts lost their unfinished traces after a Node REPL timeout; their PNG/JSON evidence survives. Four later contexts finalized traces.
Desktop 1440x900; mobile responsive viewport 390x844, not physical-device certification. Edge smoke uses the Chromium engine too.

findings.expected: The submitted research mode must agree with the canonical LOCAL_FIXTURE mode shown to the seller.
findings.actual: The page displayed LOCAL_FIXTURE/local demo data, but Find suppliers for this product submitted mode LIVE_READ_ONLY. The QA proxy rejected it with 403 before acquisition; the UI described an access problem.
reproduction: Select the synthetic Kids opportunity and follow Find suppliers.
Observe LOCAL_FIXTURE in the page.
Click Find suppliers for this product and inspect the request mode and 403.
findings.business_impact: The seller cannot trust which acquisition mode a consequential CTA will request. The test safety boundary prevented a live call.
findings.suggested_fix: Derive and validate the request mode from the canonical context; explain mode refusal without pretending it is owner-access denial. Preserve separate live authorization.

findings.expected: A context created inside a selected opportunity/supplier journey must preserve the applicable canonical references or explicitly require a scope choice.
findings.actual: The URL and journey header carried the selected opportunity and supplier. Create context returned 201 with product_id, opportunity_id and supplier_id all null.
reproduction: Open economics with opportunity_id and supplier_id query parameters for the selected synthetic product.
Enter INR, quantity 500, origin IN and destination IN.
Click Create context and inspect the persisted context response.
findings.business_impact: A seller can create detached financial work while believing it belongs to the selected product and supplier.
findings.suggested_fix: Use the existing canonical context references when constructing the draft and reject ambiguous context. Do not duplicate financial authorities.
findings.source_correlation: apps/web/src/app/intelligence/sourcing-economics-workspace.component.ts:3906-3930 posts a draft without those context references

findings.expected: Compare navigates to supplier comparison and retains applicable context.
findings.actual: The journey Compare link encodes #comparison into the path as %23comparison and lands on Dashboard instead.
reproduction: Open the product-scoped supplier workspace.
Click Compare in the supplier journey navigation.
Observe the Dashboard destination; use Back to recover.
findings.business_impact: The seller loses the apparent next step and context.
findings.suggested_fix: Use Angular fragment navigation separately from the route and preserve context query parameters.
findings.source_correlation: apps/web/src/app/intelligence/supplier-journey-nav.component.ts:115 and supplier-due-diligence.component.ts:116 embed a fragment in routerLink

findings.expected: An unassessed supplier must show unknown/unassessed gaps and an obvious supported next action to obtain an assessment.
findings.actual: The HUMAN-shortlisted supplier opened in NOT_ASSESSED state with Open gaps 0 and zero-gap copy. No assess action was found in the rendered page or its advanced section. A supplemental canonical API assessment subsequently produced three genuine missing-evidence gaps, shown after reload.
reproduction: Shortlist the synthetic supplier for verification through the UI.
Follow Verify and inspect the initial NOT_ASSESSED state and available controls.
Compare with the same context after the canonical assess API creates the gap assessment.
findings.business_impact: The seller reaches a dead end and can confuse absence of assessment with absence of evidence gaps.
findings.suggested_fix: Expose the existing assessment authority with explicit initiation, loading, unknown and blocked states. Never infer verified from zero recorded gaps.
findings.source_correlation: The inspected component loads contexts/gaps/plans and gap actions but does not expose initial context assessment.

findings.expected: Loading an absent projection explains that no assessment exists and provides the supported next action.
findings.actual: All six research-area load controls returned 404 for absent projections and retained indistinguishable not-loaded/not-researched text without a useful outcome message. The authoritative score load itself returned 200 and worked.
reproduction: Open the manual synthetic opportunity with a score but no research projections.
Click the Trend, Competition, Reviews, Supplier feasibility, Economics and Risk load controls.
Compare visible feedback with the recorded 404 responses.
findings.business_impact: Working requests appear inert and sellers cannot distinguish missing research from a broken CTA.
findings.suggested_fix: Separate not requested, loading, absent assessment, failed request and loaded states, with an accessible result message and existing research link.

findings.expected: Known canonical INR currency is displayed as INR; unavailable values remain UNKNOWN.
findings.actual: The converted product showed PARTIAL economics and Currency UNKNOWN despite the canonical projection having base_currency INR and its landed-cost calculation having INR currency.
reproduction: Prepare canonical explicitly assumed INR economics for the selected synthetic opportunity.
Open its converted Catalog product.
Inspect Economics readiness currency and compare the canonical projection.
findings.business_impact: The UI falsely reports missing information and obscures the meaning of the financial result.
findings.suggested_fix: Bind the canonical base_currency field using the documented projection contract.

findings.expected: The summary count updates after a successful shortlist/version transition.
findings.actual: Shortlists remained 0 after version evaluation and HUMAN shortlisting. Reload displayed 1 without another business action.
reproduction: Evaluate the synthetic one-supplier shortlist.
Choose Shortlist for verification.
Observe overview 0; reload and observe 1.
findings.business_impact: Contradictory confirmation encourages unnecessary retries.
findings.suggested_fix: Refresh or derive the summary from the successful canonical response without duplicating decisions.

findings.expected: An installation without an executed research run says not researched, not complete.
findings.actual: The initial opportunity screen used RESEARCH COMPLETE while no product research had executed and no candidates existed.
reproduction: Create the first owner and goal in an empty disposable installation.
Open Product Opportunities before an executed run exists.
Read the completion label and empty state.
findings.business_impact: The seller interprets an unexecuted workflow as a completed failed search.
findings.suggested_fix: Derive labels from canonical run state, distinguishing not started, blocked, no useful candidates and completed with evidence.

findings.expected: The page fits 390px; wide tables scroll inside a bounded region and long capability strings wrap.
findings.actual: At 390x844, the document measured 851px wide. A 760px table and an unbroken capability string contributed to page-level horizontal overflow.
reproduction: Open Videos at 390x844.
Scroll to Generated videos and provider capability information.
Compare document width with the 390px viewport.
findings.business_impact: Mobile controls and information are clipped or require two-direction page scrolling.
findings.suggested_fix: Contain table overflow and wrap technical strings while retaining all content and accessible table semantics.
findings.resolution_note: Original851px overflow reproduced; bounded layout preserves named keyboard-scrollable table and wraps diagnostics. Chrome360/390/768/1440 and Edge390/1440/reload pass. Underlying Video schema/API500 remains separately OPEN, not generation certification.

findings.area: Catalog mutation-error recovery and heading semantics
findings.expected: A failed listing-draft mutation preserves loaded product context and exposes an inline error and meaningful page heading.
findings.actual: When the QA guard blocked draft creation, the entire product workspace was replaced by Catalog context is unavailable. Axe reported page-has-heading-one, moderate, in this error state. Retry restored the product. The refusal was induced by the safety harness, not proof of a production draft-creation failure.
reproduction: Open the persisted Catalog product.
Attempt Start Amazon India draft under the current default-deny QA policy.
Observe loss of the loaded context and heading-one violation; click Retry.
findings.business_impact: A recoverable write error appears to destroy product context and reduces accessible navigation.
findings.suggested_fix: Retain the read model on mutation errors and render an accessible inline result with a persistent h1.
findings.resolution_note: Recoverable invalid variant mutation preserves loaded product, h1 and values; genuine initial GET outage retains accessible error/Retry. Original induced refusal evidence is preserved. Seven unrelated textarea contrast checks remain manual review, not this heading defect.

findings.expected: A seller can discover a supported conversion action for a HUMAN-selected opportunity without reconstructing its product manually.
findings.actual: No conversion action was found in the inspected selected-opportunity detail or Catalog list. A supplemental canonical conversion API succeeded and preserved opportunity/assessment/HUMAN-selection lineage. This is not a browser conversion PASS.
reproduction: Select the synthetic opportunity through the existing HUMAN action.
Inspect detail actions and Catalog list/empty-state handoffs.
Contrast with the supported conversion endpoint and resulting persisted product.
findings.business_impact: The seller cannot find how to carry research into the product master, risking duplicate manual entry and lost lineage.
findings.suggested_fix: Expose the existing conversion authority with eligibility, confirmation, idempotency and a Catalog deep link.
findings.source_correlation: Inspected Catalog and opportunity components provide no conversion invocation; Catalog empty copy mentions conversion as an option.

findings.expected: Selecting a destination closes the menu and exposes the destination content with appropriate focus.
findings.actual: The Application menu details remained open after navigation, pushing the destination below a long navigation list. Escape did close it and restore summary focus; keyboard trapping was not reproduced.
reproduction: At 390x844, open Application menu.
Choose Product Opportunities or another primary destination.
Observe the menu still open; press Escape to reveal the destination.
findings.business_impact: Navigation appears not to have worked and requires an extra recovery action on every page.
findings.suggested_fix: Close the mobile menu on successful router navigation and provide deliberate destination focus.
findings.resolution_note: Menu closes on successful NavigationEnd and focuses main content. Actual authenticated Chrome mobile keyboard Enter navigation, reload and persisted operational context passed. Original evidence and unrelated protected-login return-route finding 020 remain preserved.

findings.expected: Suppliers opens an understandable supplier/discovery overview or clearly explains its prerequisite and next action.
findings.actual: Primary Suppliers opens Make a sourcing decision, a large multi-stage sourcing/RFQ/quote workspace. The actual cross-marketplace supplier candidate/detail screen is a different destination in Advanced or the product handoff.
reproduction: Click Suppliers in primary navigation.
Read the heading and available actions.
Compare with the product's Find suppliers destination.
findings.business_impact: First-time sellers enter a later-stage commercial workspace when looking for candidate suppliers.
findings.suggested_fix: Align the primary destination and label with supplier discovery/evaluation, retaining advanced sourcing operations separately.

findings.expected: My Research foregrounds saved goals, research runs and resumable evidence relevant to the seller.
findings.actual: My Research opens Winning product research, a broad workspace containing missions, suppliers, rules, profiles and reports. At 390px it measured 10886px high.
reproduction: Click My Research from primary navigation.
Locate the current goal or saved research among the available sections.
Repeat at 390x844.
findings.business_impact: The label promises personal research history but presents a large technical workspace with competing tasks.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a focused current/recent research landing view and progressively disclose advanced configuration.

findings.expected: Show a concise decision brief, readable missing-input list and progressive access to provenance details.
findings.actual: Commercial-input warnings render raw Python-like dictionaries containing None, source_refs and identifiers. The populated mobile economics page measured 42933px high. Source authorization controls compete with the local economics task above it.
reproduction: Open the selected opportunity's economics workspace with the canonical assumed-cost fixture.
Read the assessment warning list and locate the financial summary and decision.
Repeat at 390x844 and measure document height.
findings.business_impact: The seller must interpret implementation structures and scroll through excessive detail before understanding a money decision.
findings.suggested_fix: Render typed warnings as plain-language rows; prioritize included subtotal, excluded unknowns, capital fit and the allowed next decision. Keep audit details available, not dominant.

findings.expected: Readable INR amounts, clearly labeled ratios/percentages, and preserved exact values in detail/export.
findings.actual: The UI exposes amounts such as 52562.50000000 and contribution margin 0.47910000 rather than a seller-readable INR amount and 47.91%. Independent calculations matched the canonical arithmetic; this is not a calculation defect.
reproduction: Open the populated synthetic economics assessment.
Read landed cost, contribution and contribution margin.
Compare display with the canonical values and independent calculation.
findings.business_impact: Ratios can be misread and precision noise conceals the scale of a commercial decision.
findings.suggested_fix: Apply locale-aware money and percentage display without rounding stored calculations or changing financial semantics.

findings.expected: When only draft products exist, explain active-product eligibility and link to an existing eligible next step.
findings.actual: SEO/Images/Videos say No products yet although Catalog contains two draft products. The picker legitimately requests status=active and receives zero; the copy directs the seller to create another product instead of explaining eligibility.
reproduction: Create a draft product and reopen Catalog to verify it exists.
Open SEO, Images or Videos.
Read the empty-product instruction and inspect the active-only request.
findings.business_impact: Sellers may create duplicate products and still cannot proceed.
findings.suggested_fix: Distinguish no products from no eligible active products; explain and link the existing activation/readiness workflow without bypassing it.
findings.evidence_note: The screenshot filename reflects an initial hypothesis. API inspection disproved a response-shape mismatch: the cause is the active-only filter and misleading copy.
findings.resolution_note: SEO/Images/Video explicitly explain active-only eligibility and link existing Catalog; canonical description/activation rules preserved. Actual draft-only then same-product normal UI activation tested; no duplicate product or generated evidence.

findings.expected: The empty image picker provides a discoverable safe upload/media-library path or explains how to populate it.
findings.actual: The Catalog product displayed an empty private-media picker and disabled Add image with no visible upload/library handoff in the inspected Product images section.
reproduction: Open the new synthetic Catalog product with no images.
Inspect Product images and its picker.
Attempt to identify the supported next action from that section.
findings.business_impact: The seller cannot discover how to satisfy a listing-image prerequisite from the point of need.
findings.suggested_fix: Link the existing secure media authority with product return context and explain supported image eligibility.
findings.resolution_note: Actual private local upload returns exact Catalog product and ready selection; explicit attachment remains required, authenticated preview works and anonymous preview returns 401. No external image fetch or fabricated product image.

findings.expected: At quantity entry, explain whether it records sellable stock and provide the canonical stock-entry next step.
findings.actual: A product saved with Track inventory and Quantity 12 showed 12 in product detail but no Unified Inventory item until a separate HUMAN opening-stock workflow recorded 12. The opening-stock page correctly explains the separate ledger; the product-entry point did not make the distinction apparent.
reproduction: Create a synthetic product with inventory tracking and quantity 12.
Open Unified Inventory before opening-stock entry.
Record opening stock through Review and HUMAN confirmation; reopen inventory.
findings.business_impact: Sellers may believe stock was recorded when it was not, or count it twice while trying to repair the discrepancy.
findings.suggested_fix: Clarify legacy/master quantity at entry and guide to the canonical ledger workflow. Do not silently copy or double-count stock.
findings.resolution_note: Entry/detail clarify master metadata versus ledger; exact variant review/HUMAN confirmation creates one movement despite duplicate click; reload and product-filtered ledger preserve scope. Explicit zero remains zero; cancel does not post.

findings.expected: After valid sign-in, restore the authorized internal product deep link, or clearly offer it as the next action.
findings.actual: A fresh context requesting the known Catalog product was correctly redirected to Login, but successful sign-in went to Dashboard rather than the requested product.
reproduction: Open the persisted product deep link in a new browser context with no session.
Sign in as the synthetic owner through the actual form.
Observe Dashboard instead of the product route.
findings.business_impact: Shared/bookmarked task links lose the seller's destination after authentication.
findings.suggested_fix: Preserve a validated same-origin internal return route across sign-in; retain default-deny resource authorization.
findings.resolution_note: Actual fresh Chrome/Edge desktop/mobile sign-in restores exact owned Catalog path/query/fragment and reload. Unsafe external/protocol-relative/encoded/control/traversal/outlet/auth-loop targets fail closed; authentication and backend ownership unchanged.

suspected.actual: Five axe scans reported serious color-contrast on the active Advanced navigation link, ratio 1.07, white over #f4f8f7, expected 4.5. The captured viewport screenshot shows that link against a dark selected background, so the computed-background result and screenshot need independent state/hover/scroll verification before declaring a confirmed contrast root cause.
suspected.suggested_fix: First reproduce with the exact active link scrolled/focused and mouse moved off it, inspect computed colors/stacking, then repair actual contrast if confirmed. Do not disable the axe rule.

blocked_coverage.cause: Existing QA browser policy blocks run creation. No real product discovery or Brave request was executed; the resulting generic UI failure is not proof of provider failure.
UI incorrectly requested LIVE_READ_ONLY; QA proxy refused before upstream acquisition. Explicit LOCAL_FIXTURE API fixture creation is supplementary, not browser discovery success.
Current eligible product cohort and two distinct supplier candidates were not established. Historical manual opportunities and one supplier do not prove comparison.

blocked_coverage.area: Sourcing scenario creation and listing draft creation
blocked_coverage.cause: Existing default-deny QA mutation policy blocked these browser requests. No weakening or bypass was performed.
Intentionally unauthorized and out of scope. No seller accounts, credentials, live evidence, supplier contact, publication or payments.
